anime.desc: Anime character designs, cel shading, speed lines, big VFX
anime.label: Anime / cel-shaded

classic_studs.desc: Old-school Roblox: stud textures, plastic blocky parts, classic faces, default R6 look, nostalgic
classic_studs.label: Classic / studded

dark_gritty.desc: Low-key lighting, desaturated or horror-dark palette, fog, grime
dark_gritty.label: Dark / gritty

low_poly.desc: Faceted, flat-shaded low-polygon models, minimal textures
low_poly.label: Low poly

meme_chaotic.desc: Collage of meme images, AI-brainrot characters, mismatched assets, intentionally chaotic
meme_chaotic.label: Meme / chaotic

realistic.desc: PBR materials, realistic lighting and proportions, detailed textures, often Future lighting; looks like a modern PC game
realistic.label: Realistic

simulator_bright.desc: Flat, highly saturated colours, simple shapes, neon accents, big floating numbers and UI; the typical simulator look
simulator_bright.label: Bright simulator

stylized.desc: Smooth, rounded, hand-painted or Fortnite-like cartoon look; clean gradients, exaggerated shapes
stylized.label: Stylized / cartoon

arena.desc: One combat map or a few rotating arenas built for fighting
arena.label: Arena / battleground

interior.desc: Indoor spaces: buildings, facilities, corridors, rooms (horror, stories, restaurants)
interior.label: Interiors / corridors

linear_course.desc: Stages or a track you move through in order: obbies, towers, escape runs, races
linear_course.label: Linear course / stages

lobby_rounds.desc: A lobby, then short rounds on rotating maps (party games, survival rounds, murder mysteries)
lobby_rounds.label: Lobby + round maps

open_world.desc: One large explorable world with points of interest, free roaming
open_world.label: Open world

plot_base.desc: Each player gets a plot or base inside one shared map (tycoons, steal-a games, gardens)
plot_base.label: Personal plots / bases

tower_defense_lanes.desc: Fixed enemy paths with build spots (tower defense)
tower_defense_lanes.label: Lanes / paths

town_roleplay.desc: A town or city with houses, shops and jobs, built for roleplay
town_roleplay.label: Town / city roleplay

zone_progression.desc: A spawn hub with gated zones or worlds unlocked by progress (most simulators)
zone_progression.label: Hub + zones / worlds
